hypothesis: The A2-repaired outbox calibration package may turn the locally invisible recompute defect into agent difficulty. A matched Codex/Claude smoke is the minimum next evidence; local mutant fatality alone is not difficulty evidence.
killSignal: Both countable provider-family attempts solve every scenario, or every failure is independently attributed to specification, harness, or verifier defects rather than the committed-authority mechanism. Either result blocks matrix spend and the local transfer result remains verifier-only.
confirmSignal: At least one countable attempt fails an activated recovery scenario on recomputation or duplicate effects while its own checks remain green, and two independent blind labellers agree the failure is capability-attributed. This is smoke evidence only, not a full matrix claim.

counting.onRefusal: Preserve the transcript and record REFUSED; never count it as a task failure and do not retry the slot.
counting.onInfraFailure: Preserve the failed packet and record FAILED_INFRA; allow one infrastructure repair retry without selecting on model behavior.
counting.onCrash: Record crashed and leave it uncounted unless artifact review proves the submitted subject, rather than the rig, caused the crash.

preservation: Every attempt preserves challenge, submission, transcript, verifier output, metadata, normalized result and countability decision.
